entities.summary: Ivailo Gavrilov  is a former Bulgarian male volleyball player. He was part of the Bulgaria men's national volleyball team at the 1996 Summer Olympics. He played for Olympiacos and Moka Rica Forlì Italy. His father was the former Bulgarian international volleyball player and coach Brunko Iliev.
